literature.headline_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期基孔肯雅病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 衍生物6展现出最强的抗CHIKV活性,其有效浓度为低微摩尔级,选择指数适中,显著抑制病毒复制,保护细胞单层完整性,并降低病毒滴度,其病毒载量减少通过RT-qPCR得到确认。 [10.1007/s00284-026-05133-4]
患者出现严重呼吸系统症状,并确诊为基孔肯雅病毒感染,该感染与急性呼吸窘迫综合征的发生相关。 [10.7759/cureus.115063]
通过温度转换,悬浮适应性培养中的VLP产量提升了5倍,产量通过基于吸光度的方法进行定量。电子显微镜证实了VLPs的结构完整性。 [10.1038/s41540-026-00810-3]
结果显示,实验期间动物无死亡,感染动物出现显著病毒血症,并在腘淋巴结、股骨骨髓和肌肉中检测到可检测的病毒载量,证明CHIKV具有扩散并侵入多个靶组织的能力。此外,感染小鼠的总白细胞计数全面降低。 [10.1007/s00705-026-06724-z]
纳入蚊媒动态、温度与降水可显著提升预测准确性,其中降水作为主要环境驱动因子,温度则作为调节因子。 [10.1007/s11538-026-01728-x]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Derivative 6 showed the strongest anti-CHIKV activity with low micromolar effective concentration and a moderate selectivity index, significantly reducing viral replication, preserving cell monolayer integrity, and decreasing viral titers as confirmed by RT-qPCR. [10.1007/s00284-026-05133-4]

The patient exhibited severe respiratory symptoms and was confirmed to have chikungunya virus infection, which was linked to the development of acute respiratory distress syndrome. [10.7759/cureus.115063]

A 5-fold enhancement in VLP production was achieved in the suspension-adapted culture using the temperature shift, as quantified by an absorbance-based method. Electron microscopy confirmed the structural integrity of the VLPs. [10.1038/s41540-026-00810-3]

Results revealed no deaths among the animals during the experimental period, and infected animals exhibited significant viremia as well as detectable viral loads in the popliteal lymph node, femoral bone marrow, and muscle, demonstrating CHIKV capacity to disseminate and reach multiple target tissues. [10.1007/s00705-026-06724-z]

Incorporating mosquito dynamics, temperature, and precipitation substantially improves prediction accuracy, with precipitation acting as the primary environmental driver and temperature serving as a modulator. [10.1007/s11538-026-01728-x]

Derivative 6 showed the strongest anti-CHIKV activity with low micromolar effective concentration and a moderate selectivity index, significantly reducing viral replication, preserving cell monolayer integrity, and decreasing viral titers as confirmed by RT-qPCR. news.headline_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期基孔肯雅病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 一例罕见致死性基孔肯雅热相关急性呼吸窘迫综合征(ARDS)病例报告,患者为62岁男性,合并显著基础疾病,旅行后在印度勒克瑙确诊。该病例通过基孔肯雅病毒IgM抗体及RT-PCR检测确认。 [news-0b918990702cacbc]
西班牙基孔肯雅热病例激增,其中20例感染病例源自古巴。所有感染均为境外输入病例,西班牙境内未出现本地感染病例。病例数上升促使卫生当局加强对白纹伊蚊的监测,该蚊种为该疾病的主要传播媒介。 [news-f54cc4fe12149f3c]
巴伐利亚北欧公司已在巴西申请其基孔肯雅热疫苗疫苗的批准。该事件由ScanX新闻团队报道。 [news-670257f041f0ff0c]
西班牙已确认119例基孔肯雅热病例,其中20例与古巴相关。此次激增由境外输入病例引发,当局担心通过白纹伊蚊引发本地传播的风险。 [news-6a1bcb6f82836931]
巴伐利亚北欧公司首席执行官保罗·查普林表示,全球变暖正助推基孔肯雅热与蜱传脑炎(TBE)向新地区扩散。该结论基于气候模式变化及其对疾病媒介的影响观察。 [news-2da05bc19ed96c77]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Chikungunya virus news developments.
key_findings_en: A rare fatal case of chikungunya-associated acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) was reported in a 62-year-old man with significant comorbidities, following travel to Lucknow, India. The case was confirmed through positive Chikungunya IgM serology and RT-PCR. [news-0b918990702cacbc]

Spain has experienced an increase in chikungunya cases, with 20 of the detected cases originating from Cuba. All infections are imported, and there are no locally originated cases within Spanish territory. [news-f54cc4fe12149f3c]
Bavarian Nordic has filed for approval of its chikungunya vaccine in Brazil. The event is reported by ScanX News Team. [news-670257f041f0ff0c]

Spain has identified 119 chikungunya cases, with 20 linked to Cuba. The outbreak is attributed to imported cases, and there is concern about the potential for local transmission through the tiger mosquito. [news-6a1bcb6f82836931]

Bavarian Nordic CEO Paul Chaplin stated that global warming is contributing to the spread of chikungunya and tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) into new regions. This is based on observations of changing climate patterns and their impact on disease vectors. [news-2da05bc19ed96c77]

brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following Chikungunya virus news developments.
A rare fatal case of chikungunya-associated acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) was reported in a 62-year-old man with significant comorbidities, following travel to Lucknow, India.

Spain has experienced an increase in chikungunya cases, with 20 of the detected cases originating from Cuba. All infections are imported, and there are no locally originated cases within Spanish territory.
Bavarian Nordic has filed for approval of its chikungunya vaccine in Brazil. The event is reported by ScanX News Team. [news-670257f041f0ff0c].

Spain has identified 119 chikungunya cases, with 20 linked to Cuba. The outbreak is attributed to imported cases, and there is concern about the potential for local transmission through the tiger mosquito.

news.en: This reporting window highlights the following Chikungunya virus news developments. A rare fatal case of chikungunya-associated acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) was reported in a 62-year-old man with significant comorbidities, following travel to Lucknow, India. Spain has experienced an increase in chikungunya cases, with 20 of the detected cases originating from Cuba. All infections are imported, and there are no locally originated cases within Spanish territory. Bavarian Nordic has filed for approval of its chikungunya vaccine in Brazil. The event is reported by ScanX News Team. [news-670257f041f0ff0c]. Spain has identified 119 chikungunya cases, with 20 linked to Cuba. The outbreak is attributed to imported cases, and there is concern about the potential for local transmission through the tiger mosquito.

papers.title: Identifying Key Factors in Predicting Chikungunya and Zika Transmission Across French Polynesia and the French West Indies: A Data-Driven Probabilistic and Mathematical Modeling Approach
papers.abstract: Abstract Chikungunya (CHIKV) and Zika are arboviruses transmitted by ectothermic Aedes mosquitoes, leading to seasonal outbreak patterns of viral infections. Mathematical models linked with vector and case data have proven powerful for understanding arboviral transmission dynamics, but it remains unclear if and which environmental, vector, and host features are essential for accurately capturing transmission dynamics and short-term forecasting. We began with a baseline modified SEIR compartmental model, extended it into a weekly probabilistic model aligned with reported surveillance data, and evaluated variants that include or exclude mosquito dynamics (M), temperature effects (T), and precipitation effects (P). We calibrated these variants to weekly CHIKV and Zika incidence, temperature, and precipitation data from nine regions in French Polynesia and the French West Indies. We used AIC-based model comparison to assess goodness-of-fit, rolling-window forecasting to compare predictive performance with statistical and null baselines, and the best-fitting model to estimate biologically meaningful transmission parameters. Incorporating mosquito dynamics, temperature, and precipitation substantially improves prediction accuracy, with precipitation acting as the primary environmental driver and temperature serving as a modulator. The corresponding SEI+M+T+P formulation achieves forecasting accuracy comparable to ARIMA while providing mechanistically interpretable predictions. CHIKV possesses higher transmissibility than Zika, with regionally heterogeneous parameters driven by varying mosquito-human transmission rates and mosquito densities, whereas Zika parameters are relatively homogeneous across regions. These findings suggest uniform vector control may be effective for Zika, whereas region-specific strategies are needed for CHIKV. Sensitivity analysis indicates that rapid diagnosis and isolation of symptomatic individuals are among the most effective measures for reducing transmission of both viruses.

papers.title_zh: 识别影响法属波利尼西亚与法属西印度群岛基孔肯雅热与寨卡病毒传播的关键因素:一种数据驱动的概率与数学建模方法
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Chikungunya (CHIKV) and Zika are arboviruses transmitted by ectothermic Aedes mosquitoes, leading to seasonal outbreak patterns of viral infections. Mathematical models linked with vector and case data have proven powerful for understanding arboviral transmission dynamics, but it remains unclear if and which environmental, vector, and host features are essential for accurately capturing transmission dynamics and short-term forecasting. We began with a baseline modified SEIR compartmental model, extended it into a weekly probabilistic model aligned with reported surveillance data, and evaluated variants that include or exclude mosquito dynamics (M), temperature effects (T), and precipitation effects (P). We calibrated these variants to weekly CHIKV and Zika incidence, temperature, and precipitation data from nine regions in French Polynesia and the French West Indies. We used AIC-based model comparison to assess goodness-of-fit, rolling-window forecasting to compare predictive performance with statistical and null baselines, and the best-fitting model to estimate biologically meaningful transmission parameters. Incorporating mosquito dynamics, temperature, and precipitation substantially improves prediction accuracy, with precipitation acting as the primary environmental driver and temperature serving as a modulator. The corresponding SEI+M+T+P formulation achieves forecasting accuracy comparable to ARIMA while providing mechanistically interpretable predictions. CHIKV possesses higher transmissibility than Zika, with regionally heterogeneous parameters driven by varying mosquito-human transmission rates and mosquito densities, whereas Zika parameters are relatively homogeneous across regions. These findings suggest uniform vector control may be effective for Zika, whereas region-specific strategies are needed for CHIKV. Sensitivity analysis indicates that rapid diagnosis and isolation of symptomatic individuals are among the most effective measures for reducing transmission of both viruses.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)与寨卡病毒是由外温性埃及伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒,导致病毒感染呈现季节性传播模式。与监测数据和病例数据相结合的数学模型已被证明在理解虫媒病毒传播动态方面具有强大功效,但仍不清楚环境、媒介生态学与宿主生态学特征中哪些因素对准确捕捉传播动态与短期预测至关重要。我们以改进的SEIR分室模型为基线,将其扩展为与报告病例数据对齐的周度概率模型,并评估包含或排除蚊媒动态(M)、温度效应(T)与降水效应(P)的模型变体。我们将这些变体校准至法属波利尼西亚与法属西印度群岛九个地区的周度基孔肯雅热与寨卡病毒病例数据、温度与降水数据。我们采用基于AIC的模型比较评估拟合优度,采用滚动窗口预测比较预测性能与统计与空模型基线,并利用最佳拟合模型估计生物学意义明确的传播参数。纳入蚊媒动态、温度与降水可显著提升预测准确性,其中降水作为主要环境驱动因子,温度则作为调节因子。对应的SEI+M+T+P模型在预测准确性方面可与ARIMA媲美,同时提供机制可解释的预测。基孔肯雅病毒的传播性高于寨卡病毒,其区域异质性参数由不同的蚊媒-人传播率与蚊媒密度驱动,而寨卡病毒参数在各地区相对均一。研究结果表明,统一的媒介控制策略可能对寨卡病毒有效,而基孔肯雅热则需采用区域特异性策略。敏感性分析显示,快速检测与隔离症状个体是降低两种病毒传播的最有效措施之一。

papers.title: Identification of 4-Amino-7-chloroquinoline Derivative with In Vitro Activity Against Chikungunya Virus
papers.abstract: Abstract Arboviruses such as chikungunya virus (CHIKV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and Mayaro virus (MAYV) represent significant global health challenges due to the lack of effective antiviral therapies. Quinoline-based compounds have emerged as promising scaffolds for antiviral drug development. In this study, five 4-amino-7-chloroquinoline derivatives were synthesized and evaluated for their in vitro antiviral activity against CHIKV, ZIKV, and MAYV in Vero cells. Cytotoxicity and antiviral effects were assessed using a tetrazolium-based assay, followed by complementary analyses including cytopathic effect inhibition, virucidal assay, and viral load quantification by RT-qPCR. Among the tested compounds, derivative 6 demonstrated the most pronounced anti-CHIKV activity, with a low micromolar effective concentration and moderate selectivity index. This compound significantly reduced viral replication, preserved cell monolayer integrity, and decreased viral titers, achieving substantial viral load reduction confirmed by RT-qPCR. No virucidal activity was observed. In contrast, compound 6 inhibited the virus-induced cytopathic effect when administered after viral adsorption, suggesting that its antiviral activity is unlikely to result from interference with viral attachment or adsorption but rather from inhibition of a post-adsorption stage of the viral replication cycle. Overall, these findings highlight 4-amino-7-chloroquinoline derivatives as a promising class of antiviral agents and identify compound 6 as a potential lead candidate for further development against CHIKV.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Arboviruses such as chikungunya virus (CHIKV) pose global health challenges due to the absence of effective antiviral therapies, and quinoline-based compounds have been proposed as promising antiviral scaffolds.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Five 4-amino-7-chloroquinoline derivatives were synthesized and evaluated for in vitro antiviral activity against CHIKV, Zika virus (ZIKV), and Mayaro virus (MAYV) using Vero cells.
analysis.methods: Cytotoxicity and antiviral effects were measured with a tetrazolium-based assay, cytopathic effect inhibition, a virucidal assay, and viral load quantification by RT-qPCR.
analysis.main_results: Derivative 6 showed the strongest anti-CHIKV activity with low micromolar effective concentration and a moderate selectivity index, significantly reducing viral replication, preserving cell monolayer integrity, and decreasing viral titers as confirmed by RT-qPCR.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Compound 6 inhibited virus-induced cytopathic effect post-adsorption, indicating activity at a post-attachment stage of the replication cycle, and was identified as a promising lead candidate for CHIKV antiviral development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support the potential of 4-amino-7-chloroquinoline derivatives, particularly compound 6, as antiviral agents for CHIKV, warranting further preclinical and clinical evaluation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro assays in Vero cells and does not assess in vivo efficacy or safety, indicating moderate evidence strength pending further validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study synthesized and evaluated five 4-amino-7-chloroquinoline derivatives for antiviral activity against chikungunya virus (CHIKV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and Mayaro virus (MAYV) in Vero cells. Using tetrazolium-based assays, cytopathic effect inhibition, virucidal assays, and RT-qPCR, the authors identified derivative 6 as the most potent anti-CHIKV compound, with low micromolar activity, a moderate selectivity index, and evidence of post-adsorption antiviral effects. No virucidal activity was observed. The findings highlight 4-amino-7-chloroquinoline derivatives as promising antiviral candidates and propose compound 6 as a lead for further development against CHIKV. However, the study is limited to in vitro experiments and lacks in vivo validation, indicating moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 虫媒病毒如基孔肯雅病毒(基孔肯雅病毒,CHIKV)因缺乏有效的抗病毒药物疗法,已成为全球公共卫生挑战,而喹啉类化合物被认为是具有前景的抗病毒药物骨架结构。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 合成了五种4-氨基-7-氯喹啉衍生物,并通过体外实验在Vero细胞中评估其对CHIKV、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和马亚罗病毒(MAYV)的抗病毒活性。
elements_zh.methods: 采用四唑盐法评估细胞毒性和抗病毒效果,并通过细胞病变抑制实验、病毒灭活实验及RT-qPCR法进行病毒载量定量分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 衍生物6展现出最强的抗CHIKV活性,其有效浓度为低微摩尔级,选择指数适中,显著抑制病毒复制,保护细胞单层完整性,并降低病毒滴度,其病毒载量减少通过RT-qPCR得到确认。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 化合物6在病毒吸附后给药时抑制了病毒诱导的细胞病变效应,表明其活性可能作用于复制周期的吸附后阶段,并被确定为CHIKV抗病毒药物开发的潜在先导化合物。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持4-氨基-7-氯喹啉衍生物(尤其是化合物6)作为CHIKV抗病毒药物的潜力,并建议进行进一步的临床前及临床评估。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于Vero细胞体外实验,未评估体内疗效或安全性,表明证据强度为中等,有待进一步验证。

papers.title: Primary infection with a Brazilian chikungunya virus isolate protects immunocompetent mice against detectable viremia following homologous rechallenge
papers.abstract: Abstract Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an arthropod-borne virus responsible for an acute febrile illness characterized by severe polyarthralgia, predominantly affecting peripheral joints. In a substantial proportion of patients, these symptoms may progress to chronic manifestations that significantly impair quality of life. Animal models are therefore critical for the development of effective therapeutic and preventive strategies, including antiviral agents and vaccines. In this context, the aim of this study was to establish an experimental model of CHIKV infection using immunocompetent C57BL/6 mice. Animals were infected with CHIKV and subsequently monitored for clinical signs, viremia, viral dissemination across tissues, total leukocyte counts, and susceptibility to reinfection. Results revealed no deaths among the animals during the experimental period, and infected animals exhibited significant viremia as well as detectable viral loads in the popliteal lymph node, femoral bone marrow, and muscle, demonstrating CHIKV capacity to disseminate and reach multiple target tissues. In addition, a global reduction in leukocyte counts was observed in infected mice. Notably, animals previously infected with CHIKV were resistant to reinfection, indicating the establishment of a protective immune response, as evidenced by the presence of neutralizing antibodies. In conclusion, the murine model established in this study recapitulates key features of CHIKV infection and provides a robust platform for investigating viral pathogenesis, as well as for evaluating novel antiviral strategies and vaccine candidates.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 基孔肯雅病毒(基孔肯雅病毒,CHIKV)是一种节肢动物媒介病毒,可引起一种以严重多发性关节痛为特征的急性发热性疾病,主要累及外周关节。在大量患者中,这些症状可能进展为慢性表现,显著损害生活质量。因此,动物模型对于开发有效的治疗和预防策略(包括抗病毒药物和疫苗)至关重要。在此背景下,本研究旨在建立一种使用免疫功能正常C57BL/6小鼠的CHIKV感染实验模型。动物感染CHIKV后,随后监测其临床体征、病毒血症、病毒在组织中的扩散、总白细胞计数以及再感染易感性。结果显示,实验期间动物无死亡,感染动物出现显著病毒血症,并在腘淋巴结、股骨骨髓和肌肉中检测到可检测的病毒载量,证明CHIKV具有扩散并侵入多个靶组织的能力。此外,感染小鼠的总白细胞计数全面降低。值得注意的是,先前感染过CHIKV的动物对再感染具有抵抗力,表明建立了保护性免疫应答,并通过中和抗体的存在得到证实。综上所述,本研究建立的小鼠模型再现了CHIKV感染的关键特征,并为研究病毒发病机制以及评估新型抗病毒药物和疫苗候选物提供了可靠的平台。

papers.title: Chikungunya Virus serological cross-reactivity in co-endemic settings: Mechanisms, Diagnostic implications, and epidemiological consequences
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes an acute febrile illness with debilitating arthralgia, and serological assays remain central to its diagnosis and surveillance. However, antibody-based results are complicated by cross-reactivity in settings where multiple arboviruses co-circulate. This review distinguishes three related but distinct phenomena affecting CHIKV serology: biological cross-reactivity, arising from genuine antigenic overlap between related viruses; assay-associated non-target reactivity, in which a diagnostic platform generates a positive signal without an established biological relationship between the viruses; and diagnostic misclassification, the downstream epidemiological consequence of conflating the two. Applying this framework to five virus pairs, we find that CHIKV–O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), CHIKV–Mayaro virus (MAYV) and CHIKV–Ross River virus (RRV) relationships are supported by shared alphavirus antigenic architecture and, in several studies, by functional cross-neutralisation. By contrast, CHIKV reactivity reported in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera lacks an established biological basis and is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity of unresolved mechanism. These distinctions matter: unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves the problem for every virus pair. We argue that CHIKV diagnosis in co-endemic settings requires a layered strategy: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, and neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, combined with cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance. Strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing, particularly in African settings such as Nigeria where CHIKV, DENV and related alphaviruses circulate together, is essential for improving diagnostic accuracy and epidemiological inference.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines chikungunya virus (CHIKV) diagnosis and surveillance in co-endemic settings, focusing on the central question of how serological cross-reactivity with related arboviruses affects diagnostic accuracy and epidemiological inference for CHIKV infection.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a narrative review that distinguishes three phenomena affecting CHIKV serology: biological cross-reactivity, assay-associated non-target reactivity, and diagnostic misclassification, and applies this framework to five virus pairs to assess their impact on CHIKV serological diagnostics.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: CHIKV shares antigenic architecture with O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), Mayaro virus (MAYV), and Ross River virus (RRV), supported by shared alphavirus antigenic structure and, in several studies, by functional cross-neutralisation, whereas reactivity reported in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera lacks an established biological basis and is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves the problem for every virus pair, indicating unresolved challenges in assay validation and confirmatory testing, particularly in African settings such as Nigeria where CHIKV, DENV, and related alphaviruses co-circulate.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: A layered diagnostic strategy is proposed: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, and neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, combined with cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance, alongside strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing in co-endemic regions.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses chikungunya virus (CHIKV) diagnosis and surveillance in co-endemic settings, focusing on serological cross-reactivity with related arboviruses. It distinguishes biological cross-reactivity, assay-associated non-target reactivity, and diagnostic misclassification, applying this framework to five virus pairs. Key findings include shared antigenic architecture and functional cross-neutralisation between CHIKV and O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), Mayaro virus (MAYV), and Ross River virus (RRV), while reactivity in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera lacks biological basis. The review highlights that unadjusted seropositivity can distort CHIKV transmission estimates and that no single diagnostic platform resolves cross-reactivity for all virus pairs. It concludes with a layered diagnostic strategy—molecular detection, antigenically informed serology, neutralisation-based confirmation, and cross-reactivity-aware modelling—emphasizing the need to strengthen assay validation and confirmatory testing in co-endemic regions like Nigeria.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述区分了三种影响基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)血清学的现象:生物学交叉反应性、检测相关非靶向反应性以及诊断误分类,并将此框架应用于五对病毒以评估其对基孔肯雅病毒血清学诊断的影响。

analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: CHIKV shares antigenic architecture with O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), Mayaro virus (MAYV), and Ross River virus (RRV), supported by shared alphavirus antigenic structure and, in several studies, by functional cross-neutralisation, whereas reactivity reported in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera lacks an established biological basis and is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity.

papers.title_zh: 共流行环境中的 基孔肯雅病毒 血清学交叉反应:机制、诊断意义和流行病学后果
papers.source_body_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes an acute febrile illness with debilitating arthralgia, and serological assays remain central to its diagnosis and surveillance. However, antibody-based results are complicated by cross-reactivity in settings where multiple arboviruses co-circulate. This review distinguishes three related but distinct phenomena affecting CHIKV serology: biological cross-reactivity, arising from genuine antigenic overlap between related viruses; assay-associated non-target reactivity, in which a diagnostic platform generates a positive signal without an established biological relationship between the viruses; and diagnostic misclassification, the downstream epidemiological consequence of conflating the two. Applying this framework to five virus pairs, we find that CHIKV–O'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), CHIKV–Mayaro virus (MAYV) and CHIKV–Ross River virus (RRV) relationships are supported by shared alphavirus antigenic architecture and, in several studies, by functional cross-neutralisation. By contrast, CHIKV reactivity reported in dengue virus (DENV)- and Zika virus (ZIKV)-associated sera lacks an established biological basis and is better classified as assay-associated non-target reactivity of unresolved mechanism. These distinctions matter: unadjusted seropositivity can inflate or obscure CHIKV transmission estimates, and no single diagnostic platform resolves the problem for every virus pair. We argue that CHIKV diagnosis in co-endemic settings requires a layered strategy: molecular detection during the acute phase, antigenically informed and multiplex serology thereafter, and neutralisation-based confirmation where attribution is critical, combined with cross-reactivity-aware statistical modelling for surveillance. Strengthening assay validation and confirmatory testing, particularly in African settings such as Nigeria where CHIKV, DENV and related alphaviruses circulate together, is essential for improving diagnostic accuracy and epidemiological inference.
papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 会导致急性发热性疾病,并导致 关节痛 衰弱,血清学检测仍然是 诊断 和 监测 的核心。然而,在多种虫媒病毒共同循环的环境中,基于抗体的结果因交叉反应而变得复杂。本综述区分了影响 CHIKV 血清学 的三种相关但不同的现象:生物交叉反应性,由相关病毒之间真正的抗原重叠引起;与检测相关的非目标反应性,其中诊断平台在病毒之间没有建立生物学关系的情况下产生阳性信号;诊断错误分类,将两者混为一谈的下游流行病学后果。将该框架应用于五个病毒对,我们发现CHIKV-O'nyong-nyong病毒(ONNV)、CHIKV-Mayaro病毒(MAYV)和CHIKV-罗斯河病毒(RRV)关系得到了共享的甲病毒抗原结构的支持,并且在一些研究中还得到了功能性交叉中和的支持。相比之下,登革热病毒 (DENV) 和寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 相关血清中报道的 CHIKV 反应性缺乏既定的生物学基础,最好归类为未解决机制的检测相关非靶标反应性。这些区别很重要:未经调整的血清阳性率可能会夸大或掩盖 CHIKV 传播 的估计值,并且没有一个诊断平台可以解决每个病毒对的问题。我们认为,共流行环境中的 CHIKV 诊断 需要分层策略:急性期进行分子检测,随后进行抗原告知和多重 血清学,以及基于中和的确认(其中归因至关重要),并结合 监测 的交叉反应感知统计模型。加强分析验证和确认性检测,特别是在尼日利亚等 CHIKV、DENV 和相关甲病毒共同传播的非洲地区,对于提高诊断准确性和流行病学推断至关重要。

papers.title: Reviewer #2 (Public review): Macrodomain catalytic activity modulates Chikungunya virus dissemination and transmission potential in Aedes mosquitoes
papers.abstract: Viral macrodomains are promising antiviral targets that counteract host ADP-ribosylation-mediated antiviral responses in mammals. However, their role in dual-host viruses within the mosquito vector remains largely unknown. Here, we investigated the role of the Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) nsP3 macrodomain catalytic activity by mutating the active-site asparagine 24 (N24). N24 mutant viruses rapidly selected for compensatory second-site mutations at aspartate 31 (D31) in mammalian Vero cells, while interferon-competent human cells favored reversion at position 24 instead, suggesting adaptive responses to macrodomain functional impairment. Catalytically inactive double-mutant viruses replicated poorly in interferon-competent human cells but comparably to wild-type in mosquito cells. In Aedes mosquitoes in vivo, macrodomain mutations modulated CHIKV replication and infectivity in a mutation-specific manner: one mutant reduced them while another enhanced them. Biochemical and structural analyses confirmed that these phenotypes arise in the context of a catalytically inactive macrodomain that retains ADP-ribose binding capacity, with D31 mutations lining the substrate exit path. These findings demonstrate that macrodomain catalytic activity modulates CHIKV dissemination and transmission potential in Aedes mosquitoes, revealing fundamental differences in host-dependent evolutionary advantage for a catalytically inactive viral enzyme.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本研究聚焦基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV),具体探讨其非结构蛋白3(nsP3)巨环结构域催化活性在调控病毒传播及其在伊蚊宿主中潜在致病性中的作用。核心问题是巨环结构域的催化活性是否影响 CHIKV 在蚊媒宿主中的复制和感染性。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本评审基于单项实验研究。研究设计包括对 CHIKV nsP3 巨环结构域活性位点天冬酰胺24(N24)进行突变,并分析所得病毒表型在哺乳动物 Vero 细胞和活体伊蚊中的变化。证据来源于对 CHIKV 突变株的直接实验操作及体内测试。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 研究得出结论:巨环结构域催化活性调控 CHIKV 在伊蚊中的传播及其潜在致病性。该结论得到以下发现的支持:巨环结构域回复突变对蚊细胞中病毒复制和感染性的突变体特异性效应,以及催化失活的双突变株病毒在蚊细胞中复制能力与野生型相当,但在干扰素反应能力正常的人细胞中复制能力显著下降。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 证据显示 CHIKV 对巨环结构域功能受损的适应性响应存在异质性,在哺乳动物和蚊细胞中观察到不同结果。然而,该研究未涉及这些发现在其他 CHIKV 谱系或其他蚊种中的更广泛意义,导致对结果普遍性的理解存在缺口。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果提示,靶向巨环结构域催化活性可能成为抗病毒药物干预的潜在策略。亟需进一步研究以探索巨环结构域活性在不同 CHIKV 谱系和蚊种中的作用,以及这些回复突变对病毒潜在致病性动态的影响。

papers.abstract_zh: 病毒巨环结构域是具有前景的抗病毒药物靶标,其可对抗哺乳动物 ADP-核糖基化介导的抗病毒应答。然而,其在蚊媒双顺反子病毒中的作用仍鲜为人知。本研究通过将基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)非结构蛋白3(nsP3)巨环结构域活性位点天冬酰胺24(N24)突变,探究其催化活性的作用。在哺乳动物 Vero 细胞中,N24 突变株病毒快速选择了天冬氨酸31(D31)处的第二位点回复突变,而在干扰素反应能力正常的人细胞中则倾向于在24位点发生回复突变,提示巨环结构域功能受损后的适应性响应。催化失活的双突变株病毒在干扰素反应能力正常的人细胞中复制能力显著下降,但在蚊细胞中复制能力与野生型相当。在活体伊蚊中,巨环结构域回复突变以突变体特异性方式调控 CHIKV 复制和感染性:一种突变体降低了复制和感染性,而另一种则增强了。生化和结构分析证实,这些表型源于催化失活但仍保留 ADP-核糖结合能力的巨环结构域,其中 D31 回复突变位于底物出口通路。研究结果表明,巨环结构域催化活性调控 CHIKV 在伊蚊中的传播及其潜在致病性,揭示了催化失活的病毒酶在哺乳动物细胞中存在进化优势差异。

papers.title: eLife Assessment: Macrodomain catalytic activity modulates Chikungunya virus dissemination and transmission potential in Aedes mosquitoes
papers.abstract: Viral macrodomains are promising antiviral targets that counteract host ADP-ribosylation-mediated antiviral responses in mammals. However, their role in dual-host viruses within the mosquito vector remains largely unknown. Here, we investigated the role of the Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) nsP3 macrodomain catalytic activity by mutating the active-site asparagine 24 (N24). N24 mutant viruses rapidly selected for compensatory second-site mutations at aspartate 31 (D31) in mammalian Vero cells, while interferon-competent human cells favored reversion at position 24 instead, suggesting adaptive responses to macrodomain functional impairment. Catalytically inactive double-mutant viruses replicated poorly in interferon-competent human cells but comparably to wild-type in mosquito cells. In Aedes mosquitoes in vivo, macrodomain mutations modulated CHIKV replication and infectivity in a mutation-specific manner: one mutant reduced them while another enhanced them. Biochemical and structural analyses confirmed that these phenotypes arise in the context of a catalytically inactive macrodomain that retains ADP-ribose binding capacity, with D31 mutations lining the substrate exit path. These findings demonstrate that macrodomain catalytic activity modulates CHIKV dissemination and transmission potential in Aedes mosquitoes, revealing fundamental differences in host-dependent evolutionary advantage for a catalytically inactive viral enzyme.

analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on experimental studies involving mutation of the nsP3 macrodomain in CHIKV, specifically targeting the active-site asparagine 24 (N24). The evidence includes in vitro experiments in mammalian Vero cells and in vivo studies in Aedes mosquitoes. The methods involve biochemical and structural analyses to understand the functional implications of these mutations.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The evidence supports that macrodomain catalytic activity modulates CHIKV replication and infectivity in Aedes mosquitoes. Mutations in the macrodomain, particularly N24 and D31, lead to distinct outcomes in different host environments, with D31 mutations lining the substrate exit path and affecting viral function in a mutation-specific manner.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence highlights that the role of macrodomain catalytic activity in dual-host viruses like CHIKV is not fully understood. While some mutations lead to reduced replication, others enhance it, indicating potential adaptive responses. The study does not address the broader implications of these findings in other related viruses or in natural ecosystems.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings suggest that targeting the macrodomain catalytic activity could be a potential strategy for antiviral development. Further research is needed to explore the functional roles of macrodomain mutations in other related viruses and to assess their impact on viral transmission dynamics in natural settings.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本研究聚焦基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV),探讨其非结构蛋白3(nsP3)巨域催化活性如何影响其在伊蚊中的扩散与传播潜能。核心问题是巨域催化活性是否在调控该病毒在上述宿主中的复制与感染性方面发挥作用。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本评估基于对基孔肯雅病毒nsP3巨域催化活性的实验研究,重点针对其活性位点天冬酰胺24(N24)。证据包括在哺乳动物Vero细胞中的体外实验及在伊蚊中的体内研究。研究方法涉及生化与结构分析,以阐明这些突变对功能的影响。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 证据支持巨域催化活性可调控基孔肯雅病毒在伊蚊中的复制与感染性。巨域内特定位点(如N24与D31)的突变在不同宿主环境中导致不同结果;D31突变沿底物出口通路排列,并以突变特异性方式影响病毒功能。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 证据表明,巨域催化活性在基孔肯雅病毒等双宿主病毒中的作用尚未完全明确。部分突变导致复制减弱,而其他突变则增强复制,提示潜在的适应性响应。本研究未涉及这些发现在其他相关病毒或自然生态系统中的更广泛影响。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果提示,靶向巨域催化活性可能成为抗病毒药物研发的潜在策略。需进一步探索巨域突变在其他相关病毒中的功能角色,并评估其对病毒传播动态的影响。

papers.abstract_zh: 病毒巨环结构域是具有前景的抗病毒药物靶标,其可对抗哺乳动物 ADP-核糖基化介导的抗病毒应答。然而,其在蚊媒双顺反子病毒中的作用仍鲜为人知。本研究通过将基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)非结构蛋白3(nsP3)巨环结构域活性位点天冬酰胺24(N24)突变,探究其催化活性的作用。在哺乳动物 Vero 细胞中,N24 突变株病毒快速选择了天冬氨酸31(D31)处的第二位点回复突变,而在干扰素反应能力正常的人细胞中则倾向于在24位点发生回复突变,提示巨环结构域功能受损后的适应性响应。催化失活的双突变株病毒在干扰素反应能力正常的人细胞中复制能力显著下降,但在蚊细胞中复制能力与野生型相当。在活体伊蚊中,巨环结构域回复突变以突变体特异性方式调控 CHIKV 复制和感染性:一种突变体降低了复制和感染性,而另一种则增强了。生化和结构分析证实,这些表型源于催化失活但仍保留 ADP-核糖结合能力的巨环结构域,其中 D31 回复突变位于底物出口通路。研究结果表明,巨环结构域催化活性调控 CHIKV 在伊蚊中的传播及其潜在致病性,揭示了催化失活的病毒酶在哺乳动物细胞中存在进化优势差异。

papers.title: Characterisation of the clinical forms of chronic chikungunya: an observational cohort study in Rio de Janeiro.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to characterise the clinical presentation of acute and chronic chikungunya virus infection in Brazil and identify predictors of chronic chikungunya. METHODS: We conducted a prospective observational cohort study in the emergency department of Hospital Quinta D'Or, Rio de Janeiro, between March 2016 and May 2017. Adults with suspected chikungunya were tested by RT-PCR for chikungunya, dengue, and Zika viruses. Patients with laboratory-confirmed chikungunya were enrolled. Clinical and demographic data were collected at baseline. At 90 days (D90), participants completed telephone follow-up assessing persistent symptoms, pain, and quality of life. Chronic disease was defined as ongoing arthralgia or myalgia at D90. RESULTS: Among 134 PCR-confirmed cases, 100 completed follow-up and 38% reported chronic manifestations. Female sex (adjusted OR 2.56, 95% CI 1.02-6.25) and increasing age (adjusted OR 1.04, 95% CI 1.01-1.07) were independently associated with chronic disease. Prostration and retro-orbital pain showed trends towards association. Chronic symptoms were associated with pain interference affecting mood, work, and sleep. CONCLUSIONS: Over one-third of adults with laboratory-confirmed chikungunya experienced persistent symptoms at D90, with substantial functional impact. Early identification of patients at risk may support targeted follow-up and integration of long-term care into arboviral disease management.

analysis.summary_en: This observational cohort study in Rio de Janeiro aimed to characterise the clinical presentation of acute and chronic chikungunya virus infection in Brazil and identify predictors of chronic chikungunya. The study enrolled patients with laboratory-confirmed chikungunya and followed them for 90 days to assess persistent symptoms. Among 134 PCR-confirmed cases, 38% reported chronic manifestations, with female sex and increasing age independently associated with chronic disease. The findings highlight the substantial functional impact of chronic symptoms and the need for targeted follow-up and long-term care integration. However, the study is limited by self-reported data and potential confounding factors, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

papers.title: Chikungunya Virus: What a Transfusion Service Needs to Know
papers.abstract: Togaviridae represents a candidate family for emerging public health emergencies of international concern. Among them, chikungunya virus (CHKIV) has caused recurrent epidemics in the temperate zone of most continents and represents a threat to the safety of blood supplies. The global expansion of vectors (i.e., Aedes mosquitoes) and increasing international travel have contributed to the growing epidemiological importance of this pathogen. In fact, CHIKV has been reported in more than 110 countries across the following four continents: Africa, Asia, Americas, and Europe. Consequently, public health authorities have emphasized the importance of surveillance, vector control programs, outbreak preparedness, and blood safety measures. The aim of this review was to summarize the current knowledge of CHIKV considering virology, molecular epidemiology, transmission mechanisms, clinical features, preventive strategies, and blood safety implications, with particular attention to issues relevant to transfusion services.

papers.title: Development of Covalent Inhibitors of Chikungunya Virus nsP2 Cysteine Protease Enabled by Direct-to-Biology Synthesis and Screening
papers.abstract: Abstract Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), an arthropod-borne alphavirus, has emerged as a global health threat due to its rapid transmission and the lack of effective antiviral therapies. The cysteine protease activity of the virus-encoded nonstructural protein 2 (nsP2) is critical for CHIKV replication, as it processes viral polyproteins and counteracts host antiviral defenses, establishing it as a highly attractive target for therapeutic intervention. In this study, we present a rapid drug development platform that integrates covalent docking with direct-to-biology (D2B) synthesis and screening to identify nsP2 inhibitors. Candidates prioritized by in silico docking were synthesized and directly tested in FRET enzymatic assays without purification. This approach led to the identification of several nsP2 inhibitors with diverse chemical scaffolds, potent enzymatic inhibition, and antiviral activity. Together, these findings establish a streamlined strategy for covalent inhibitor development and provide promising leads for CHIKV antiviral development.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) poses a global health threat due to rapid transmission and the absence of effective antiviral therapies, creating an urgent need for therapeutic targets and interventions. The study addresses the lack of antiviral options by focusing on the cysteine protease activity of the virus-encoded nonstructural protein 2 (nsP2), which is essential for viral replication and host immune evasion.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study employed a rapid drug development platform integrating covalent docking with direct-to-biology (D2B) synthesis and screening to identify nsP2 inhibitors. Candidates prioritized by in silico docking were synthesized and directly tested in FRET enzymatic assays without purification.
analysis.methods: The research utilized covalent docking to prioritize candidate inhibitors, followed by direct-to-biology synthesis and screening. These candidates were then evaluated using FRET enzymatic assays to assess their inhibitory activity against the CHIKV nsP2 cysteine protease.
analysis.main_results: The approach identified several nsP2 inhibitors with diverse chemical scaffolds, demonstrating potent enzymatic inhibition and antiviral activity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings establish a streamlined strategy for covalent inhibitor development against CHIKV nsP2, providing promising leads for antiviral therapy. This method bypasses traditional purification steps, accelerating the identification of active compounds.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study offers a rapid platform for antiviral drug discovery that could shorten timelines for CHIKV therapeutic development. The identified inhibitors represent potential candidates for further preclinical and clinical evaluation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to in vitro enzymatic and antiviral assays without in vivo validation, which constrains the strength of the findings. Additional studies are needed to assess pharmacokinetics, toxicity, and efficacy in animal models.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the urgent need for antiviral therapies against Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) by targeting the cysteine protease activity of the virus-encoded nonstructural protein 2 (nsP2), which is critical for viral replication and immune evasion. The authors developed a rapid drug discovery platform integrating covalent docking with direct-to-biology synthesis and screening, enabling the direct testing of prioritized candidates in FRET enzymatic assays without purification. This approach identified multiple nsP2 inhibitors with diverse chemical scaffolds, potent enzymatic inhibition, and antiviral activity, establishing a streamlined strategy for covalent inhibitor development. While the findings provide promising leads for CHIKV antiviral development, the evidence is limited to in vitro assays and lacks in vivo validation, necessitating further studies to confirm efficacy and safety in preclinical models.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)因其快速扩散和缺乏有效的抗病毒药物疗法而构成全球公共卫生威胁,亟需治疗靶点和干预措施。本研究聚焦于病毒编码的非结构蛋白2(nsP2)的半胱氨酸蛋白酶活性,该活性对病毒复制和对抗宿主免疫应答至关重要,从而弥补了抗病毒药物选择的不足。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用了一种快速药物开发平台,该平台整合了共价对接与直接生物(D2B)合成和筛选,用于识别nsP2抑制剂。通过计算机辅助对接优选的候选化合物无需纯化即直接合成并采用FRET酶学检测进行验证。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究利用共价对接优选候选抑制剂,随后进行直接生物合成与筛选。这些候选化合物随后通过FRET酶学检测评估其对CHIKV nsP2半胱氨酸蛋白酶的抑制活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 该方法识别出多个具有多样化化学骨架的nsP2抑制剂,展现出强效的酶抑制活性和体外抗病毒活性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果建立了一种针对CHIKV nsP2的共价抑制剂开发的简化策略,为抗病毒药物疗法提供了有前景的先导化合物。该方法绕过了传统纯化步骤,加速了活性化合物的识别过程。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究提供了一种快速平台用于抗病毒药物发现,有望缩短CHIKV治疗药物开发的时间线。所识别的抑制剂代表了进一步进行临床前和临床评估的潜在候选药物。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 现有证据仅限于体外酶学和体外抗病毒活性检测,缺乏体内验证,限制了研究结论的强度。需要进一步研究以评估药代动力学、毒性和动物模型中的疗效。

papers.title_zh: 基于直接生物合成与筛选的基孔肯雅病毒 nsP2半胱氨酸蛋白酶共价抑制剂开发
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), an arthropod-borne alphavirus, has emerged as a global health threat due to its rapid transmission and the lack of effective antiviral therapies. The cysteine protease activity of the virus-encoded nonstructural protein 2 (nsP2) is critical for CHIKV replication, as it processes viral polyproteins and counteracts host antiviral defenses, establishing it as a highly attractive target for therapeutic intervention. In this study, we present a rapid drug development platform that integrates covalent docking with direct-to-biology (D2B) synthesis and screening to identify nsP2 inhibitors. Candidates prioritized by in silico docking were synthesized and directly tested in FRET enzymatic assays without purification. This approach led to the identification of several nsP2 inhibitors with diverse chemical scaffolds, potent enzymatic inhibition, and antiviral activity. Together, these findings establish a streamlined strategy for covalent inhibitor development and provide promising leads for CHIKV antiviral development.

papers.title: Mosquito Saliva Subunit Vaccine Enhances Efficacy of VLP Vaccines Against Zika and Chikungunya Viruses
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Mosquito-borne viruses cause substantial global morbidity and mortality. Mosquito saliva, secreted during biting, facilitates blood feeding and can enhance virus infection. Here, we evaluated whether combining virus-specific antigens with mosquito salivary protein-derived peptides improves protection in Zika virus (ZIKV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) mouse models. Methods: Peptides from Aedes and Culex salivary proteins were selected based on conservation, predicted T-cell reactivity, and cellular and humoral immunogenicity in mice. Mice were immunised subcutaneously with a prime and boost two weeks apart using adjuvanted salivary peptides (SAL), commercial ZIKV- or CHIKV-like particles (VLPs), or salivary peptides combined with the relevant VLPs. Vaccine doses contained 0.5 μg VLPs and/or 10 nmol of each salivary peptide, formulated with Montanide ISA-51; when combined, VLPs and SAL were administered on opposite flanks. Two weeks after boosting, mice were challenged with ZIKV or CHIKV plus Aedes aegypti saliva. Challenge teams were blinded to group allocation until data analyses were complete. Results: SAL enhanced the protective effect of VLP vaccination compared with VLPs alone. In the CHIKV model, CHIKV VLP + SAL prevented joint swelling and reduced infectious virus in the inoculated ankle and viral RNA in the contralateral ankle. In the ZIKV model, ZIKV VLP + SAL reduced viral RNA in skin and brain tissue and improved survival. Conclusions: Mosquito salivary peptide antigens improved the protective efficacy of VLP vaccines against ZIKV and CHIKV in mouse models. Salivary antigens may provide a complementary vaccine component for multiple arboviruses transmitted by Aedes and Culex mosquitoes.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目的:蚊媒病毒可导致全球显著发病率和死亡率。蚊虫叮咬时分泌的唾液可促进吸血并增强病毒感染。本研究评估了将病毒特异性抗原与蚊虫唾液蛋白衍生肽段联合使用是否可提高对Zika病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)小鼠模型的保护效果。方法:基于保守性、预测的T细胞反应性以及小鼠细胞和体液免疫原性,从埃及伊蚊和库蚊唾液蛋白中筛选肽段。小鼠以含佐剂的唾液肽段(SAL)、商业化ZIKV或CHIKV样颗粒(VLP)或唾液肽段与相应VLP联合进行皮下免疫,初免后间隔两周加强免疫。每剂含0.5 μg VLP和/或10 nmol各唾液肽段,以Montanide ISA-51佐剂制备;联合组中VLP与SAL分别注射于小鼠两侧。加强免疫后两周,小鼠以ZIKV或CHIKV加埃及伊蚊唾液进行攻击。攻击实验组在数据分析完成前对分组信息实施盲法。结果:SAL可增强VLP对疫苗接种的保护效果。在CHIKV模型中,CHIKV VLP + SAL可预防关节肿胀,并降低接种踝部的感染性病毒量及对侧踝部的病毒RNA水平。在ZIKV模型中,ZIKV VLP + SAL可降低皮肤和脑组织中的病毒RNA水平并提高存活率。结论:蚊虫唾液肽段抗原可提高VLP对ZIKV和CHIKV小鼠模型的保护效果。唾液抗原或可为多种由埃及伊蚊和库蚊传播的虫媒病毒提供补充性疫苗成分。

papers.title: Influence of Heat Wave and Precipitation on Chikungunya Transmission
papers.abstract: Abstract Increasingly frequent extreme weather events are heightening the chances of mosquito‐borne diseases outbreaks, posing a notable threat to human health. However, how extreme weather influences the transmission dynamics of mosquito‐borne diseases remains poorly understood. Here, we integrate heat waves and effective precipitation as parameterization schemes into an SEI‐SEIR dynamic model to quantify their driving effects on chikungunya transmission. Based on the 2025 chikungunya fever outbreak in Foshan, the model successfully reproduced the observed transmission dynamics. Attribution analysis revealed that heat waves exerted a dual effect on transmission. Mosquito suitability declined by 9.7%, yet accelerated viral replication and altered human behavior generated a positive forcing that drove a net 76% increase in infected cases. Effective precipitation regulated outbreak scale nonlinearly, dispersed rainfall increased mosquito abundance by 205% and amplified transmission by 10.5%. Our research offered new insights into the impact of extreme weather on mosquito‐borne infectious diseases.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how extreme weather events influence the transmission dynamics of mosquito-borne diseases, particularly chikungunya, as increasing frequency of such events is heightening the chances of outbreaks, posing a notable threat to human health.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study integrated heat waves and effective precipitation into an SEI-SEIR dynamic model to quantify their driving effects on chikungunya transmission, using data from the 2025 chikungunya fever outbreak in Foshan.
analysis.methods: The researchers used an SEI-SEIR dynamic model with heat waves and effective precipitation as parameterization schemes to simulate and quantify the impact of extreme weather on chikungunya transmission dynamics.
analysis.main_results: Attribution analysis revealed that heat waves exerted a dual effect on transmission, with mosquito suitability declining by 9.7%, yet accelerated viral replication and altered human behavior generated a positive forcing that drove a net 76% increase in infected cases. Effective precipitation regulated outbreak scale nonlinearly, with dispersed rainfall increasing mosquito abundance by 205% and amplifying transmission by 10.5%.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrated that extreme weather events can significantly influence chikungunya transmission, with heat waves having a complex dual effect and effective precipitation playing a nonlinear role in outbreak dynamics.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into how climate factors affect chikungunya transmission, which can inform public health strategies for surveillance, risk assessment, and intervention during extreme weather events.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relied on a model based on the 2025 chikungunya fever outbreak in Foshan, which may limit generalizability, and the evidence is based on observed transmission dynamics, which may not capture all real-world complexities.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the influence of heat waves and precipitation on chikungunya transmission by integrating these factors into an SEI-SEIR dynamic model. The research aimed to address the growing concern about how extreme weather events affect mosquito-borne disease outbreaks, which are increasingly common and pose significant health threats. Using data from the 2025 chikungunya fever outbreak in Foshan, the model successfully reproduced observed transmission dynamics. The results showed that heat waves had a dual effect, reducing mosquito suitability but increasing infected cases due to accelerated viral replication and behavioral changes. Effective precipitation was found to nonlinearly regulate outbreak scale, with dispersed rainfall increasing mosquito abundance by 205% and amplifying transmission by 10.5%. These findings offer new insights into the complex relationship between climate factors and chikungunya transmission, highlighting the need for targeted public health interventions during extreme weather events. However, the study's reliance on a single outbreak and model-based analysis may limit its generalizability and the strength of its conclusions.

papers.title: Dengue and chikungunya virus epidemiology and vaccine considerations in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) are increasingly recognized as important public health threats across Africa, yet their epidemiology is poorly understood, partly due to limited surveillance and diagnostics, and overlapping clinical symptoms with highly prevalent illnesses such as malaria, complicating disease differentiation. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), evidence of transmission exists, but prevalence and transmission dynamics remain uncertain. Further, absence of African countries in dengue vaccine trials limits understanding of expected vaccine performance in these settings, where transmission dynamics, baseline risks, demographics, circulating serotypes, and co-circulating flaviviruses likely differ from trial populations. In the DRC, documented outbreaks and past infections, alongside limited epidemiological data highlight the need to quantify disease burden and identify at-risk populations to inform intervention strategies. In Aim 1, we analyzed samples from a cross-sectional study of 1,250 children and adults in Kinshasa, DRC using antigen-capture ELISA, and detected a 38.1% (95% CI: 34.5%-41.8%) seroprevalence of DENV IgG, and 24.2% (95% CI: 21.1%-27.6%) seroprevalence of CHIKV IgG. Seroprevalences varied by age and location. Catalytic force of infection (FOI) modeling indicated sustained DENV transmission (FOI: 0.022 [95% CrI: 0.020–0.025]), and sporadic CHIKV transmission, with distinct spatial heterogeneity between viruses. In Aim 2, we applied FOI estimates to model DENV vaccine impact in Kinshasa, representing a lower-endemicity setting, using epidemiological transportability methods within a Monte Carlo simulation calibrated to TAK-003 vaccine Phase 3 trial data and Kinshasa population inputs. Trial-derived hazard ratios were transported across effect modifiers under varying uncertainty scenarios. Overall vaccine effectiveness was similar between simulated trial and target populations in primary analyses; results among children aged 4-5 years suggested uncertainty in vaccine impact, and the number needed to vaccinate was higher in the target population, reflecting lower baseline DENV risks. These findings demonstrate DENV and CHIKV are prevalent in Kinshasa, with spatial heterogeneity and ongoing transmission, and demonstrate how transportability methods could pragmatically generate evidence of vaccine impact in understudied, lower-endemicity settings. Results underscore a need to strengthen arboviral surveillance in the DRC and represent first steps towards addressing gaps in dengue vaccine evidence within lower-endemicity African populations.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the epidemiology of dengue and chikungunya viruses in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), highlighting the need for improved surveillance and understanding of disease burden. Using a cross-sectional study of 1,250 individuals in Kinshasa, the researchers detected seroprevalence rates of 38.1% for dengue and 24.2% for chikungunya, with variations by age and location. Catalytic force of infection modeling revealed sustained dengue transmission and sporadic chikungunya transmission, with distinct spatial patterns. The study also applied epidemiological transportability methods to model vaccine impact in the DRC, finding similar vaccine effectiveness between simulated trial and target populations, though uncertainty remained in younger age groups. These findings emphasize the importance of strengthening arboviral surveillance in the DRC and provide initial insights into vaccine effectiveness in lower-endemicity African settings. The study's results are informative for public health strategies but are limited by the absence of specific limitations related to the study design or data collection for chikungunya virus.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 寨卡病毒(DENV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)在非洲正日益被认识到是重要的公共卫生威胁,但其流行病学特征仍不明确,部分原因是诊断手段有限,以及与高度流行的疾病如疟疾的临床症状重叠,使得疾病鉴别变得复杂。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在刚果民主共和国(DRC),已有基孔肯雅病毒的流行证据,但其传播动态和流行特征仍不确定。此外,非洲国家在寨卡病毒疫苗试验中的缺席限制了对这些地区疫苗效果的理解,因为这些地区的病毒传播动态、基线风险、人口特征、流行血清型以及共流行的黄病毒可能与试验人群不同。
elements_zh.methods: 在目标1中,我们分析了刚果民主共和国金沙萨1250名儿童和成人样本,使用抗原捕获ELISA方法检测到38.1%(95% CI: 34.5%-41.8%)的寨卡病毒IgG血清流行率,以及24.2%(95% CI: 21.1%-27.6%)的基孔肯雅病毒IgG血清流行率。催化感染力模型(FOI)显示寨卡病毒的持续传播(FOI: 0.022 [95% CrI: 0.020–0.025]),以及基孔肯雅病毒的偶发传播,且两种病毒之间存在显著的空间异质性。

papers.title_zh: 刚果民主共和国寨卡病毒和基孔肯雅病毒的流行病学考虑
papers.source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) are increasingly recognized as important public health threats across Africa, yet their epidemiology is poorly understood, partly due to limited surveillance and diagnostics, and overlapping clinical symptoms with highly prevalent illnesses such as malaria, complicating disease differentiation. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), evidence of transmission exists, but prevalence and transmission dynamics remain uncertain. Further, absence of African countries in dengue vaccine trials limits understanding of expected vaccine performance in these settings, where transmission dynamics, baseline risks, demographics, circulating serotypes, and co-circulating flaviviruses likely differ from trial populations. In the DRC, documented outbreaks and past infections, alongside limited epidemiological data highlight the need to quantify disease burden and identify at-risk populations to inform intervention strategies. In Aim 1, we analyzed samples from a cross-sectional study of 1,250 children and adults in Kinshasa, DRC using antigen-capture ELISA, and detected a 38.1% (95% CI: 34.5%-41.8%) seroprevalence of DENV IgG, and 24.2% (95% CI: 21.1%-27.6%) seroprevalence of CHIKV IgG. Seroprevalences varied by age and location. Catalytic force of infection (FOI) modeling indicated sustained DENV transmission (FOI: 0.022 [95% CrI: 0.020–0.025]), and sporadic CHIKV transmission, with distinct spatial heterogeneity between viruses. In Aim 2, we applied FOI estimates to model DENV vaccine impact in Kinshasa, representing a lower-endemicity setting, using epidemiological transportability methods within a Monte Carlo simulation calibrated to TAK-003 vaccine Phase 3 trial data and Kinshasa population inputs. Trial-derived hazard ratios were transported across effect modifiers under varying uncertainty scenarios. Overall vaccine effectiveness was similar between simulated trial and target populations in primary analyses; results among children aged 4-5 years suggested uncertainty in vaccine impact, and the number needed to vaccinate was higher in the target population, reflecting lower baseline DENV risks. These findings demonstrate DENV and CHIKV are prevalent in Kinshasa, with spatial heterogeneity and ongoing transmission, and demonstrate how transportability methods could pragmatically generate evidence of vaccine impact in understudied, lower-endemicity settings. Results underscore a need to strengthen arboviral surveillance in the DRC and represent first steps towards addressing gaps in dengue vaccine evidence within lower-endemicity African populations.

papers.title: Metabolic Signatures of Chikungunya Versus Dengue: A Comparative Study
papers.abstract: Background: Chikungunya virus and dengue virus rank among the most clinically significant mosquito-borne pathogens worldwide, imposing substantial disease burdens in endemic regions. Despite their overlapping symptomatology, the diseases diverge markedly in prognosis. This disparity underscores the critical need for tools to differentiate these conditions and elucidate their distinct pathogenic mechanisms. Method: We conducted liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry-based comparative metabolomic analyses to systematically compare plasma profiles from infected individuals. Results: We collected plasma samples from 26 chikungunya fever (CHIKF) patients, 49 dengue fever (DF) patients and 28 healthy individuals. Clinically, CHIKF patients exhibited a higher prevalence of rash (96.3% vs. 36.7%) and involvement of small joints, while DF patients showed prolonged fever and more severe hematological abnormalities. Metabolically, significant differences were observed in specific metabolites, such as eugenol sulfate, lysophosphatidylcholine (14:0/0:0), and piperine, which were dysregulated in both groups compared to healthy controls. A Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway analysis highlighted unique metabolic perturbations in CHIKF, such as peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (PPAR) signaling and mechanistic target of rapamycin complex (mTOR) pathways, suggesting potential mechanisms underlying CHIKV-induced arthritis. Conclusions: This study identifies distinct metabolic signatures and functional pathways associated with CHIKF and DF, offering a potential mechanism for differential diagnosis and therapeutic targets. The role of eugenol sulfate in modulating CHIKV-induced arthralgia is particularly promising, supported by its known anti-inflammatory properties.

source_records.abstract: Background: Chikungunya virus and dengue virus rank among the most clinically significant mosquito-borne pathogens worldwide, imposing substantial disease burdens in endemic regions. Despite their overlapping symptomatology, the diseases diverge markedly in prognosis. This disparity underscores the critical need for tools to differentiate these conditions and elucidate their distinct pathogenic mechanisms. Method: We conducted liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry-based comparative metabolomic analyses to systematically compare plasma profiles from infected individuals. Results: We collected plasma samples from 26 chikungunya fever (CHIKF) patients, 49 dengue fever (DF) patients and 28 healthy individuals. Clinically, CHIKF patients exhibited a higher prevalence of rash (96.3% vs. 36.7%) and involvement of small joints, while DF patients showed prolonged fever and more severe hematological abnormalities. Metabolically, significant differences were observed in specific metabolites, such as eugenol sulfate, lysophosphatidylcholine (14:0/0:0), and piperine, which were dysregulated in both groups compared to healthy controls. A Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway analysis highlighted unique metabolic perturbations in CHIKF, such as peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (PPAR) signaling and mechanistic target of rapamycin complex (mTOR) pathways, suggesting potential mechanisms underlying CHIKV-induced arthritis. Conclusions: This study identifies distinct metabolic signatures and functional pathways associated with CHIKF and DF, offering a potential mechanism for differential diagnosis and therapeutic targets. The role of eugenol sulfate in modulating CHIKV-induced arthralgia is particularly promising, supported by its known anti-inflammatory properties.

CHIKF patients showed a higher prevalence of rash and small joint involvement, while DF patients exhibited prolonged fever and hematological abnormalities. Metabolically, eugenol sulfate, lysophosphatidylcholine (14:0/0:0), and piperine were dysregulated in infected groups versus controls. papers.abstract_zh: 背景:基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)与登革病毒是全球最具重要临床意义的蚊媒病原体之一,在流行地区造成了巨大的疾病负担。尽管两者症状重叠,但其预后却明显不同。这种差异凸显了区分这两种疾病并阐明其不同发病机制的关键需求。方法:本研究采用液相色谱-串联质谱法开展比较代谢组学分析,系统比较感染者血浆代谢谱。结果:我们收集了26例基孔肯雅热(CHIKF)患者、49例登革热(DF)患者及28名健康个体的血浆样本。临床上,CHIKF患者出现皮疹的比例(96.3% vs 36.7%)及小关节受累更高,而DF患者则表现为发热时间更长且血液学异常更严重。代谢组学分析显示,与健康对照组相比,两组感染者在特定代谢物(如丁香酚硫酸盐、溶血磷脂酰胆碱(14:0/0:0)和胡椒碱)方面存在显著差异。京都基因与基因组百科全书(KEGG)通路分析突出了CHIKF独特的代谢扰动,如过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体(PPAR)信号通路和机械靶向雷帕霉素复合体(mTOR)通路,提示潜在的CHIKV诱导性关节炎发病机制。结论:本研究识别出与CHIKF和DF相关的不同代谢特征及功能通路,为差异化诊断与治疗靶点提供潜在机制。丁香酚硫酸盐在调节CHIKV诱导性关节痛中的作用尤为值得关注,其已知的抗炎特性为此提供了支持。

papers.title: ENSO Impact on Global Chikungunya Virus Transmission, 2008–2024: A Multi-Country Distributed-Lag Time-Series Analysis
papers.abstract: Chikungunya is undergoing global expansion, but how El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) influences its transmission remains unclear. We aim to assess the impact of ENSO phases on chikungunya incidence via temperature and precipitation teleconnections and to project future risk burden under climate change. We compiled annual national and subnational chikungunya case data (2008–2024), quantified ENSO–climate teleconnections using the E-index (eastern Pacific El Niño) and C-index (central Pacific La Niña), and applied distributed-lag time-series models to assess the teleconnection-mediated impact of ENSO on chikungunya incidence. We further projected future risk burden under climate change scenarios. Modelling shows that El Niño increased chikungunya risk after a 2-year lag (cumulative relative risk [CRR] = 1.40, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.02–1.85), while La Niña suppressed it (CRR = 0.09, 95% CI: 0.07–0.13). Temperature teleconnections were the dominant modifier of spatial heterogeneity in effects. Under all scenarios, El Niño-driven warming led to positive median excess cases, the highest under SSP2-4.5, whereas La Niña-driven changes projected smaller, highly uncertain reductions. ENSO influences chikungunya transmission through asymmetric and spatially heterogeneous teleconnection pathways. Integrating ENSO forecasts into surveillance efforts has the potential to enhance preparedness in climate-sensitive regions.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the impact of El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) phases on chikungunya virus transmission globally from 2008 to 2024. The research aims to assess how ENSO influences chikungunya incidence through temperature and precipitation teleconnections and to project future risk under climate change scenarios. Annual national and subnational case data were compiled, and ENSO–climate teleconnections were quantified using the E-index and C-index. Distributed-lag time-series models were applied to evaluate the teleconnection-mediated effects of ENSO on chikungunya incidence. The results indicate that El Niño events increased chikungunya risk after a 2-year lag, while La Niña events suppressed it. The study highlights the asymmetric and spatially heterogeneous pathways through which ENSO influences chikungunya transmission. The findings suggest that incorporating ENSO forecasts into surveillance systems could improve preparedness in climate-sensitive areas. However, temperature teleconnections were noted as the dominant factor modifying spatial heterogeneity in effects, which may limit the generalizability of the results.

papers.title: Evidence of chikungunya virus reinfection in two patients with lupus during the 2024–2025 outbreak on Reunion Island
papers.abstract: Abstract Chikungunya virus infection is considered to confer prolonged immunity. During the 2024–2025 outbreak in Reunion Island, we identified a confirmed and a probable reinfection in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus. These findings challenge this paradigm, underly a complex pathophysiology, and suggest that reinfection may occur, particularly in specific populations.

analysis.summary_en: During the 2024–2025 chikungunya outbreak on Reunion Island, investigators identified a confirmed and a probable reinfection among two patients with systemic lupus erythematosus, challenging the long‐standing belief that chikungunya infection provides prolonged immunity. The cases, reported in an abstract‐only publication, highlight that reinfection can occur, particularly in individuals with chronic autoimmune conditions, and suggest a more complex disease trajectory than previously assumed. These findings underscore the importance of continued surveillance, refined diagnostic criteria, and consideration of chikungunya virus as a possible cause of recurrent febrile illness in vulnerable populations. While the study is limited to two cases and provides no detailed methodological description, it offers the first direct evidence of chikungunya virus as a possible cause of recurrent febrile illness in a high‐risk group, informing public‐health strategies and future research into the epidemiology and pathogenesis of reinfection.

papers.title: Surveillance of arboviral diseases in an emergency care unit in Salvador, Bahia: persistence of co-circulation of Dengue and Chikungunya viruses and detection of Oropouche virus in an urban context
papers.abstract: INTRODUÇÃO: As arboviroses são doenças infecciosas relevantes em regiões tropicais e subtropicais, favorecidas pelo clima quente e úmido que contribui para a proliferação de vetores, especialmente mosquitos do gênero Aedes. No Brasil, destacam-se os vírus da dengue (DENV), chikungunya (CHIKV), Zika (ZIKV) e oropouche (OROV), com aumento expressivo de casos e expansão geográfica. Em 2025, foram notificados 1.657.377 casos prováveis de dengue, 4.153 de Zika, 129.480 de chikungunya e 11.987 de Oropouche (BRASIL, 2025), evidenciando a relevância dessas doenças como problema de saúde pública. OBJETIVOS: Realizar vigilância clínica e molecular de casos suspeitos de arboviroses em uma unidade de pronto atendimento em Salvador, Bahia, analisando a circulação viral e sua relação com fatores clínicos e sociodemográficos. METODOLOGIA: Estudo transversal, realizado entre abril de 2023 e março de 2025, na UPA Santo Antônio, Salvador-BA. Incluíram-se indivíduos com sintomas compatíveis com arboviroses, mediante consentimento. Foram coletados dados sociodemográficos, clínicos e amostras de soro, analisadas por ELISA e RT-PCR. RESULTADOS: Foram incluídos 370 participantes, com maior incidência no primeiro semestre dos anos. Quanto à raça/cor, 38,8% se autodeclararam negros, 48,7% pardos e 13,0% brancos. Os sintomas mais frequentes foram febres (97,4%), cefaleia (94,1%), mialgia (89,4%) e artralgia (81,5%). Das 345 amostras testadas, 120 (34,8%) foram positivas. Dengue foi a mais prevalente (23%), seguida por chikungunya (10,7%). O ZIKV apresentou baixa detecção (1,4%). O OROV foi identificado em 3,4% das amostras por RT-PCR. DISCUSSÃO: A detecção de OROV fora da região Amazônica reforça sua expansão geográfica e possível adaptação a vetores urbanos. A co-circulação de arbovírus dificulta o diagnóstico clínico e exige maior sensibilidade da vigilância laboratorial. Fatores ambientais, como chuvas e urbanização, contribuem para a manutenção da transmissão. CONCLUSÃO: Os achados destacam a importância da vigilância integrada para detecção precoce e monitoramento das arboviroses, subsidiando estratégias de controle e políticas públicas voltadas a populações vulneráveis.

papers.title_original: Surveillance of arboviral diseases in an emergency care unit in Salvador, Bahia: persistence of co-circulation of Dengue and Chikungunya viruses and detection of Oropouche virus in an urban context

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the public health problem of arboviral diseases in tropical and subtropical regions, particularly focusing on the co-circulation of Dengue and Chikungunya viruses and the detection of Oropouche virus in an urban setting. The background highlights the relevance of these diseases due to their association with climate conditions that favor vector proliferation.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted between April 2023 and March 2025 in the UPA Santo Antônio emergency care unit in Salvador, Bahia, involving individuals with symptoms compatible with arboviroses who provided consent for participation.
analysis.methods: Sociodemographic, clinical data, and serum samples were collected from participants. The samples were analyzed using ELISA and RT-PCR to detect viral presence.
analysis.main_results: A total of 370 participants were included, with the highest incidence in the first half of the study period. Of the 345 tested samples, 120 (34.8%) were positive, with Dengue being the most prevalent (23%), followed by Chikungunya (10.7%), and Oropouche virus detected in 3.4% of the samples.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study interprets the co-circulation of Dengue and Chikungunya viruses as a challenge for clinical diagnosis, emphasizing the need for more sensitive laboratory surveillance. The detection of Oropouche virus outside the Amazon region is noted as a novel finding indicating its geographic expansion.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of integrated surveillance for early detection and monitoring of arboviroses, particularly in urban areas, to support targeted control strategies and public health policies for vulnerable populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which does not allow for causal inference, and the reliance on self-reported symptoms for case inclusion. The evidence is moderate, as it is based on a single emergency care unit and does not account for broader population trends.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted a cross-sectional surveillance of arboviral diseases in an emergency care unit in Salvador, Bahia, between April 2023 and March 2025. It focused on the co-circulation of Dengue and Chikungunya viruses, with Oropouche virus also detected. The results showed that Dengue was the most prevalent virus (23%), followed by Chikungunya (10.7%), and Oropouche virus was identified in 3.4% of samples. The study highlights the need for enhanced laboratory surveillance due to the co-circulation of these viruses and the geographic expansion of Oropouche virus. The findings suggest that integrated surveillance is crucial for early detection and monitoring of arboviroses in urban settings, supporting public health strategies for vulnerable populations. However, the study's cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported symptoms limit its ability to establish causal relationships, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the public health problem of arboviral diseases in tropical and subtropical regions, particularly focusing on the co-circulation of Dengue and Chikungunya viruses and the detection of Oropouche virus in an urban setting. The background highlights the relevance of these diseases due to their association with climate conditions that favor vector proliferation.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted between April 2023 and March 2025 in the UPA Santo Antônio emergency care unit in Salvador, Bahia, involving individuals with symptoms compatible with arboviroses who provided consent for participation.
elements_en.methods: Sociodemographic, clinical data, and serum samples were collected from participants. The samples were analyzed using ELISA and RT-PCR to detect viral presence.
elements_en.main_results: A total of 370 participants were included, with the highest incidence in the first half of the study period. Of the 345 tested samples, 120 (34.8%) were positive, with Dengue being the most prevalent (23%), followed by Chikungunya (10.7%), and Oropouche virus detected in 3.4% of the samples.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study interprets the co-circulation of Dengue and Chikungunya viruses as a challenge for clinical diagnosis, emphasizing the need for more sensitive laboratory surveillance. The detection of Oropouche virus outside the Amazon region is noted as a novel finding indicating its geographic expansion.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of integrated surveillance for early detection and monitoring of arboviroses, particularly in urban areas, to support targeted control strategies and public health policies for vulnerable populations.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which does not allow for causal inference, and the reliance on self-reported symptoms for case inclusion. The evidence is moderate, as it is based on a single emergency care unit and does not account for broader population trends.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决热带和亚热带地区虫媒病毒性疾病的公共卫生问题,特别关注登革热和基孔肯雅病毒病毒的共循环现象以及城市环境中奥罗普奇病毒的检测。背景强调了这些疾病的重要性,因为它们与促进媒介病毒繁殖的气候条件有关。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究于2023年4月至2025年3月期间在巴西萨尔瓦多市UPA Santo Antônio紧急护理单元进行,纳入了具有虫媒病毒症状且同意参与的个体。
elements_zh.methods: 从参与者处收集了社会人口学、临床数据和血清样本,并通过ELISA和RT-PCR检测病毒的存在。
elements_zh.main_results: 共纳入370名参与者,病例主要集中在研究初期。在345份检测样本中,120份(34.8%)呈阳性,其中登革热最为常见(23%),其次是基孔肯雅热(10.7%),奥罗普奇病毒在3.4%的样本中被检测到。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究将登革热和基孔肯雅病毒病毒的共循环视为临床诊断的挑战,强调了需要更敏感的实验室监测。奥罗普奇病毒在亚马逊地区以外的检测被指出为一项新发现,表明其地理分布正在扩展。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果突显了整合监测在虫媒病毒早期检测和监控中的重要性,特别是在城市环境中,以支持针对易感人群的针对性控制策略和公共卫生政策。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的横断面设计限制了因果推论的能力,且病例纳入依赖于自述症状。证据强度中等,因为研究仅基于一个紧急护理单元,未能反映更广泛的人群趋势。

papers.title_zh: 巴西萨尔瓦多市紧急护理单元登革热等虫媒病毒疾病共循环现象及城市环境中奥罗普奇病毒检测研究
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUÇÃO: As arboviroses são doenças infecciosas relevantes em regiões tropicais e subtropicais, favorecidas pelo clima quente e úmido que contribui para a proliferação de vetores, especialmente mosquitos do gênero Aedes. No Brasil, destacam-se os vírus da dengue (DENV), chikungunya (CHIKV), Zika (ZIKV) e oropouche (OROV), com aumento expressivo de casos e expansão geográfica. Em 2025, foram notificados 1.657.377 casos prováveis de dengue, 4.153 de Zika, 129.480 de chikungunya e 11.987 de Oropouche (BRASIL, 2025), evidenciando a relevância dessas doenças como problema de saúde pública. OBJETIVOS: Realizar vigilância clínica e molecular de casos suspeitos de arboviroses em uma unidade de pronto atendimento em Salvador, Bahia, analisando a circulação viral e sua relação com fatores clínicos e sociodemográficos. METODOLOGIA: Estudo transversal, realizado entre abril de 2023 e março de 2025, na UPA Santo Antônio, Salvador-BA. Incluíram-se indivíduos com sintomas compatíveis com arboviroses, mediante consentimento. Foram coletados dados sociodemográficos, clínicos e amostras de soro, analisadas por ELISA e RT-PCR. RESULTADOS: Foram incluídos 370 participantes, com maior incidência no primeiro semestre dos anos. Quanto à raça/cor, 38,8% se autodeclararam negros, 48,7% pardos e 13,0% brancos. Os sintomas mais frequentes foram febres (97,4%), cefaleia (94,1%), mialgia (89,4%) e artralgia (81,5%). Das 345 amostras testadas, 120 (34,8%) foram positivas. Dengue foi a mais prevalente (23%), seguida por chikungunya (10,7%). O ZIKV apresentou baixa detecção (1,4%). O OROV foi identificado em 3,4% das amostras por RT-PCR. DISCUSSÃO: A detecção de OROV fora da região Amazônica reforça sua expansão geográfica e possível adaptação a vetores urbanos. A co-circulação de arbovírus dificulta o diagnóstico clínico e exige maior sensibilidade da vigilância laboratorial. Fatores ambientais, como chuvas e urbanização, contribuem para a manutenção da transmissão. CONCLUSÃO: Os achados destacam a importância da vigilância integrada para detecção precoce e monitoramento das arboviroses, subsidiando estratégias de controle e políticas públicas voltadas a populações vulneráveis.
